senses.gloss:
वठ् r. 1st cl. (वठति) To be large, powerful or able; also वठ(इ)वठि
(वण्ठते) To move alone or unaccompanied.

वठर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
 1. Vile, wicked, abandoned.
 2. Stupid, slow, dull.
m. (-रः)
 1. A blockhead, a fool.
 2. A physician.
 3. A waterpot. E.
वच् to speak, अरच् aff., and च changed to ठ ।

वाठ्य mfn. (-ट्यः-ट्या-ट्यं) Belonging to a house or garden, &c.
 E. वाटी, and यत् aff.
